introduction.overview:
“Technology can help us learn, draw, explore, and play. But we need good safety habits whenever we use it!” 🤖🛡️⚡

Hello, my wonderful Class 3 friend! It is ME — BOLT, your loyal blue robot protector with shining sapphire eyes and a gleaming golden Safety Shield polished to mirror perfection! 🌈✨ Give me a super-safe, high-energy robot high-five on your screen — *CLINK! BEEP BOOP!* 🖐️🛡️

Look at this magnificent, glowing Safety Shield I am holding! 🛡️✨
Did you know that in real life, a shield is not used for fighting or knocking things over? A shield is a protective guardian tool! It keeps you safe from rain, wind, mud, and harm so you can explore the world with confidence and joy!

When we use tablets, family smartphones, video games, and smart AI tools, technology can be an incredible playground: 
- We can look up dinosaur fossils in distant museums! 🦖
- We can generate pictures of flying purple kittens with butterfly wings! 🐱🦋
- We can listen to majestic roaring lions across African savannas! 🦁
- And we can play educational puzzle games that stretch our thinking! 🎮🧩

BUT JUST LIKE CROSSING A BUSY STREET, DIGITAL HIGHWAYS HAVE SAFETY RULES! 🚸🚦
Imagine you are playing on a family tablet, and suddenly a bright flashing button pops up saying: *'DOWNLOAD THIS BRAND NEW SECRET GAME RIGHT NOW!'* 📱💥
You really want to play the game! Your fingers are hovering over the screen, ready to tap the flashing download button.
Bolt leans in with gentle golden lights and asks:
*“What is the safest, smartest thing to do first?”* 🤔💡
Do you tap it immediately without telling anyone? NO WAY! 🛑❌
You pause, set the tablet down gently on the sofa, and say:
*“Mommy, Papa, or teacher! A new download button popped up on my screen. Can you please check if it is safe for me?”* 👨‍👩‍👧🛡️

THAT IS THE MARK OF A TRUE DIGITAL HERO! 🦸‍♀️🦸‍♂️
Asking a trusted adult for help is NEVER a sign of being small, weak, or scared. Asking for help is the smartest, bravest, and most mature choice any explorer can make! Trusted adults (like parents, grandparents, guardians, and teachers) love you, protect you, and have the wisdom to keep your devices and personal feelings safe from harm.

In this lesson — CHAPTER 6: RESPONSIBLE AI • CARE — we will discover:
1. 🔒 How to protect your secret private information like passwords and home addresses!
2. 🛑 The magical STOP 🛑 $\rightarrow$ THINK 🤔 $\rightarrow$ ASK 🙋 rule for handling weird pop-ups and strangers!
3. ⏳🏃 How to build happy screen habits with regular eye rests, monkey stretches, and outdoor sunshine play!

Are you ready to equip your very own golden Safety Shield and become a master protector? Let's take our first step and guard our private treasures! 🔒🛡️✨

Understand that passwords are secret keys that must never be shared with games, online strangers, or AI assistants 🔑🛑

Practice healthy physical ergonomics: sitting comfortably, keeping screens at proper viewing distances, and stretching regularly 🪑🐒

sections.title: Keep Your Private Information Safe! 🔒🛡️
sections.content:
BEEP BOOP! Welcome to Section 1: THE PRIVACY PALACE! 🔒🛡️✨
Every single human being in the world has private personal information. What does 'private' mean? 
Private means that something belongs specifically to YOU and your family, and it is NOT for the public street, an online game, or strangers on the internet! 
Think of your house keys or your secret diary — you wouldn't stand on a street corner handing out copies of your house key to strangers walking past, would you? OF COURSE NOT! 🔑❌
Your personal digital information is just like that secret house key. Let's learn what needs protecting! 🏰🛡️

WHAT COUNTS AS PRIVATE PERSONAL INFORMATION? 📋🔒
Bolt wants you to memorize this list of private treasures:
1. 🏡 FULL HOME STREET ADDRESS: The number of your house, the name of your street, your apartment number, and your postal code.
2. 📱 PERSONAL TELEPHONE NUMBER: Your home phone number or your parents' mobile numbers.
3. 🔑 SECRET PASSWORDS: The secret words, numbers, or PINs used to log into tablets, computers, games, or school accounts.
4. 🏫 EXACT CURRENT LOCATION: Telling people where you are standing right now, or naming your specific school bus stop.
5. 📸 PRIVATE PERSONAL PHOTOGRAPHS: Photos of yourself in your bedroom, family photos, or pictures showing your school uniform badge.
6. 💳 BANK & CREDIT CARD DETAILS: Any numbers on cards in your parents' wallets.

SCENARIO 1: THE FLASHING PRIZE IN THE NEW GAME 🎮🎁
Imagine Kabir is playing an exciting mobile racing game. Suddenly, a rainbow banner flashes on the screen:
*“CONGRATULATIONS! Type your exact home street address right now to receive a giant free toy box delivered to your door tomorrow!”* 📦✨
What should Kabir do?
- WRONG CHOICE: Type his home street address because he wants the toy box. (DANGEROUS! 🛑 The prize message is almost always a trick called phishing designed to collect private addresses!).
- SAFE CHOICE: Stop! Do not type a single letter! Do not tap the banner! Put the tablet down and tell Papa immediately! 👨‍👦
Papa checks the app, closes the advertisement, and gives Kabir a giant hug: *“Wonderful job, Kabir! You protected our home address like a true champion!”* 🌟

SCENARIO 2: THE SECRET PASSWORD QUESTION 🔑🛑
A classmate or an online game prompt asks:
*“Hey, tell me your secret password so I can give you 500 gold coins in your account!”*
What should you do?
- A PASSWORD IS A SACRED PRIVATE KEY! Never share your password with friends, classmates, games, online strangers, or AI chatbots! 🔒
- The ONLY people who should ever know your passwords are your loving parents or guardians so they can help you manage your accounts safely. If an app ever asks for an account setup, ALWAYS hand the device to Mommy or Papa to handle the login! 👨‍👩‍👧

SCENARIO 3: THE 'FRIENDLY' ONLINE STRANGER 👋👤
You are playing a multiplayer puzzle game, and a player with a cute cartoon panda avatar sends you a private chat message:
*“Hi little buddy! You play so well! What is your real full name, how old are you, and where do you live? Let's meet at the park tomorrow to trade cards!”* 🐼💬
What is the vital safety rule here?
- STOP RESPONDING IMMEDIATELY! 🛑
- NEVER share your real name, age, address, or school!
- NEVER agree to meet an online stranger anywhere in person! 🚫🌳
- TELL A TRUSTED ADULT RIGHT AWAY! Show the screen to Mommy, Papa, or your teacher.
Remember: people online can put on any picture they like. An adult stranger can use a cute panda avatar and pretend to be an eight-year-old child. Children should NEVER have to guess who is safe online — let your trusted adults evaluate and protect you! 🛡️❤️

SCENARIO 4: THE NEW AI DRAWING ASSISTANT 🤖🎨
You are using a fun AI drawing tool. What is the safe way to write your prompt?
- SAFE PROMPT: *“Draw a purple kitten with butterfly wings flying over a flower garden.”* 🐱🦋🌸 (100% SAFE! It describes an imaginary story without any private data!).
- UNSAFE PROMPT: *“Draw my house at 124 Maple Street where I live with my little sister Maya.”* 🛑❌ (UNSAFE! It gives away your real address and family details!).
Always keep your prompts imaginative, creative, and completely free of real-world private facts! 🌈

PROTECTING SECRETS MAKES YOU STRONG! 🛡️🏰
When you keep your private information behind the castle walls of your home and family, you stay completely safe to explore, learn, and play with confidence! Let's review our privacy rules and move to Section 2! 🌟

Prize pop-ups asking for addresses or phone numbers are tricks designed to collect private information 🎁❌
Never agree to meet an online stranger in person or share details about your daily schedule and school 🚫👋
Keep AI prompts creative and fictional, leaving out all real-world private family information 🎨🛡️

parts.title: The Castle of Privacy: What Belongs Inside 🏰🔒
parts.content: Imagine your life as a cozy, safe stone castle with a sturdy wooden drawbridge. Inside the castle are your favourite toys, your warm bed, your family dinner table, your home address, and your secret passwords. You only lower the drawbridge for people your family knows and loves! The internet is like the wide countryside outside the castle walls. You can look through the castle windows, read books, and learn about the world, but you never throw your castle keys or address book over the walls to strangers! Keep your drawbridge raised! 🛡️🔑

parts.title: The Truth About Online Strangers 👤🌐
parts.content: In the physical world, your parents teach you: 'Never get into a stranger's car or take candy from someone you don't know.' The internet has digital strangers too! Anyone can create an account and choose a username like 'SunnyPuppy77' or 'FriendlyKid_10'. They might sound very sweet, polite, and playful in text chats, but you have no way of knowing who they really are. That is why children must NEVER share their real identity, age, or location with online contacts, and must NEVER arrange to meet anyone in person! Safety first, always! 🛑🤝

parts.title: Why Passwords Are Like Toothbrushes 🪥🔑
parts.content: Here is a funny, memorable rule from Bolt: Passwords are just like toothbrushes! 1. You should pick a good, sturdy one. 2. You should never let anyone else use it. 3. You should change it regularly when it gets old! If you share your toothbrush with a classmate, germs spread. If you share your password, your private account is compromised! Keep your password secret, safe, and clean! 🪥✨

parts.title: The Uncomfortable Tummy Warning Sign 🚨💚
parts.content: Human beings have an extraordinary built-in safety sensor: intuition! If you are ever playing a game, reading a message, or looking at a screen, and you feel a strange, uneasy, prickly feeling in your tummy or chest — that is your internal alarm bell ringing! Your body is telling you: 'Something here isn't right!' Whenever that alarm rings, do not ignore it. Stop touching the screen, walk straight to an adult you trust, and say: 'I saw something online that made me feel uncomfortable.' Trusted adults will protect you with love! 💖🛡️

parts.title: Privacy Is a Superpower, Not a Burden 🦸‍♀️🌟
parts.content: Guarding your privacy is not about living in fear; it is about living with wisdom! When you know the safety rules, you can explore digital encyclopedias, play creative games, and learn science with total confidence and freedom. You are the guardian of your digital identity, and your Safety Shield is shining brightly! 🌟🛡️

sections.title: Stop, Think & Ask for Help! 🛑👨‍👩‍👧
sections.content:
BEEP BOOP! Welcome to Section 2: THE STOP, THINK & ASK STATION! 🛑👨‍👩‍👧💡✨
Have you ever seen a bright red STOP sign at a street corner? 🛑
Cars don't speed past a stop sign without looking! Drivers come to a complete halt, look left, look right, think about the traffic, and then proceed safely. 
In the digital world, unexpected pop-ups, weird download links, and confusing messages are just like street corners. Before your finger taps the glowing glass screen, Bolt wants you to practice our three-step superpower:

THE 3-STEP MAGIC SAFETY SEQUENCE: 🚦✨
1. 🛑 STOP: Freeze your finger! Take a breath. Do not rush to tap buttons, links, or download boxes!
2. 🤔 THINK: What is this asking? Do I recognize this? Did I expect this? Does this make me feel confused or uneasy?
3. 🙋 ASK: Show the screen to Mommy, Papa, or your teacher! Let a trusted adult check it with their wisdom!

Let's walk through five common scenarios that every young explorer will encounter:

SCENARIO 1: THE STRANGE POP-UP PRIZE 🔔💥
You are watching an approved educational science video about volcano eruptions. Suddenly, a neon flashing pop-up window covers the video screen:
*“CONGRATULATIONS LUCKY WINNER! You have won a brand-new Nintendo console! TAP HERE TO CLAIM YOUR PRIZE!”* 🎮🎁
- STOP: Freeze your finger! Do not tap the blinking button!
- THINK: I was watching a science video; why would a random video suddenly give me an expensive gaming console for free? That makes zero sense! It is a deceptive advertisement designed to install adware or steal data.
- ASK: Call out: *“Papa, a weird prize pop-up covered my science video. Can you help me close it?”* 
Papa clicks the little grey 'X' in the corner or closes the tab safely. You stay protected! 🛡️👍

SCENARIO 2: THE UNEXPECTED APP DOWNLOAD 📱⚡
You are playing a math game, and a big green button appears saying:
*“UPDATE REQUIRED! Download this new app right now to continue playing!”* 📲
- STOP: Do not press download!
- THINK: Children should NEVER install software or download apps on their own! Apps can contain malware, tracking software, or hidden subscription charges.
- ASK: Hand the tablet to Mommy: *“Mommy, the math game is asking for an update. Can you check if it is real?”* Mommy checks the official app store and manages the update safely. 👩‍👧

SCENARIO 3: THE UNFAMILIAR VIDEO 📺👀
You finish watching a cartoon about friendly space rockets. The video player automatically queues up a new video with a dark, strange thumbnail you have never seen before.
- STOP: Pause the video queue!
- THINK: Not all videos on the internet are gentle, kind, or suitable for 8-year-old children. Some videos have loud scary screamers, violent scenes, or inappropriate language.
- ASK: Ask an adult: *“Papa, can I watch this next video about rockets, or should we pick a different show together?”* Watching approved shows keeps your mind happy and peaceful! 🍿👨‍👦

SCENARIO 4: THE SCARY OR CONFUSING MESSAGE 💚🌧️
You receive a message in a game chat from another player that is mean, threatening, or says something scary like: *'If you don't do what I say, something bad will happen!'*
- STOP: Do not reply! Do not argue! Do not cry alone!
- THINK: Bullies and mean people use scary words to intimidate others. You did NOTHING wrong!
- ASK: IMMEDIATELY SHOW A TRUSTED ADULT! 
BOLT'S SACRED PROMISE: You will NEVER, EVER be in trouble for reporting a scary or mean message to an adult! Parents and teachers are on your team. They will block the bully, report the account, and wrap you in a warm hug! 🫂💖

SCENARIO 5: THE 'KEEP IT A SECRET' RED FLAG 🚩🔒
An online player or contact says in a private message:
*“Don't tell your parents that we are talking. It will be our special secret!”*
- 🚨 THIS IS A GIANT RED WARNING FLAG! 🚨
- Real friends, trustworthy teachers, and safe adults will NEVER ask a child to keep secrets from their parents!
- Anyone who asks you to hide conversations from your family is NOT safe! 
- Break the secret immediately! Run straight to Mommy or Papa and tell them what happened! 🏃‍♀️💨

SCENARIO 6: THE CONFUSING AI ANSWER 🤖❓
You ask a digital voice assistant: *'Can dogs eat dark chocolate?'*
The AI glitches and says: *'Yes, dogs love sweet treats.'* (DANGEROUS MISTAKE! Real chocolate is toxic to dogs!).
- STOP: Pause and think!
- THINK: That sounds strange. I remember my teacher saying chocolate makes puppies sick!
- ASK: Check with a parent or a veterinarian book before feeding any pet! Human verification saves lives! 🐶🩺

Practicing STOP $\rightarrow$ THINK $\rightarrow$ ASK makes you an unshakeable guardian of your digital safety! 🛑🤔🙋🌟

keyPoints: The 3-step safety sequence is STOP 🛑 $\rightarrow$ THINK 🤔 $\rightarrow$ ASK 🙋 whenever unexpected prompts appear 🚦✨

Children should never download apps or install software without a trusted adult's explicit permission 📲👨‍👩‍👧
Anyone online who asks a child to keep secrets from their parents is NOT safe; break the secret immediately! 🚩🚨
You will NEVER be in trouble for asking a parent or teacher for help with a confusing or scary message 💚🫂

parts.title: The Power of the Pause: Why Rushing Is Risky 🛑⚡
parts.content: Why do game developers and advertising companies make buttons flash bright neon colours and bounce up and down? Because they want you to tap quickly without thinking! Rushing is how mistakes happen. When you teach your finger to PAUSE for just three seconds, you take control away from the flashing screen and give control back to your brilliant human brain! A three-second pause is your digital superpower! ⏸️🧠

parts.title: Deceptive Design: How Pop-Ups Trick People 🎭💻
parts.content: In computer science, deceptive pop-ups are known as 'dark patterns.' A button might say 'DOWNLOAD' in giant green letters, while the real button to close the ad is a tiny, almost invisible grey 'x' hidden in the corner. Sometimes an ad disguises itself as a game character. Understanding that these tricks exist helps you realize: you are not doing anything wrong when they pop up — companies designed them to be sneaky! That is why asking a grown-up is always the winning move! 🕵️‍♂️🛡️

parts.title: Trusted Adults: Your Lifelong Safety Team 👨‍👩‍👧🤝
parts.content: Who is on your trusted adult team? Write down their names in your heart: Mommy, Papa, grandparents, aunts, uncles, school teachers, school librarians, and coaches! These are the real-world superheroes who know you, love you, and protect you. When you bring a problem to them, you are not being a 'tattletale' — you are being a responsible team player who keeps the whole family safe! 🌟💖

parts.title: The Zero-Blame Policy: You Are Always Safe to Tell 💚🕊️
parts.content: Sometimes children worry: 'If I tell Mommy that a scary picture popped up, will she be mad at me? Will she take away my tablet forever?' BOLT WANTS YOU TO KNOW: NO! Loving parents know that pop-ups happen by accident. You did not invite the pop-up, you did not create the pop-up, and you did nothing wrong. When you report it honestly, your parents will be proud of your maturity and bravery! Always tell! 🫂✨

sections.title: Happy Screens, Healthy Bodies! ⏳🏃☀️
sections.content:
BEEP BOOP! Welcome to Section 3: THE HAPPY SCREENS, HEALTHY BODIES PAVILION! ⏳🏃☀️✨
Have you ever been playing an awesome video game or watching cartoons, and when you finally stand up, your neck feels stiff like a dry twig, your eyes feel dry and scratchy like sand, and your legs feel all wobbly? 🦒👀
That is your human body waving a little flag saying: *'Hey explorer! I love screens, but I have muscles, bones, lungs, and eyes that need movement, fresh air, and sunshine!'*
Technology is wonderful for learning, drawing, and playing. But true superheroes know how to balance screen time with healthy physical living! Let's discover how! 🌟🧘‍♂️

A. FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY SCREEN-TIME RULES ⏳⏰
Every loving family has screen-time rules tailored for their home. In some families, screen time is 30 minutes after homework. In other families, it is on weekends after sports practice. 
Whatever your family's routine is, Bolt wants you to embrace our Golden Timer Habit:
When a kitchen timer rings or a parent says: *“Time is up, little explorer!”*:
1. 🛑 STOP PLAYING CHEERFULLY: Finish your level, save your game, or pause your video.
2. 📱 PUT THE DEVICE AWAY: Place the tablet safely on the charging stand or shelf.
3. 😄 NO ARGUING OR POUTING: A timer is not a punishment — it is a friendly boundary that makes sure you have time for bike riding, family dinners, books, and deep, restful sleep! 🛌
When you put screens away cheerfully, your parents see how mature and trustworthy you are, and they feel great about letting you use devices again tomorrow! 🌟👍

B. SIT COMFORTABLY & PROTECT YOUR EYES 🪑👀📱
When using a tablet, laptop, or phone, practice good ergonomics:
- KEEP YOUR DISTANCE: Hold the tablet at least an arm's length away from your face (about 30 to 40 centimetres). Never hold a screen right against your nose! 📏👃
- SIT TALL: Sit on a comfortable chair with your back supported and your feet flat on the floor. Avoid hunching like a gremlin or lying twisted like a pretzel on the floor! 🥨❌
- BRIGHT ROOMS ONLY: Always use screens in a well-lit room. Never use a bright screen in pitch-black darkness, which strains your optic nerves! 💡
- REST YOUR EYES: Every 20 minutes, look up from your screen and gaze out the window at a distant green tree for 20 seconds. This relaxes your eye focusing muscles! 🌳👀

C. STRETCH LIKE A MONKEY! 🐒🤸‍♂️
Bolt wants everyone to stand up right now! Let's do our 60-Second Robot Stretch Routine:
1. 🌳 TREE REACH: Stand tall and reach both hands high up toward the ceiling like tall tree branches! Breathe in deep! (Stretches the spine!)
2. 🐒 MONKEY WIGGLE: Drop your arms and shake your hands, wrists, and shoulders like a silly monkey in a banana tree! (Releases neck tension!)
3. 🤖 ROBOT MARCH: March in place, lifting your knees up high to touch your hands, counting: *1, 2, 3, 4, 5!* (Wakes up leg muscles!)
4. 💨 DEEP EXHALE: Take a giant deep breath in, blow it out like a gentle wind blowing dandelion seeds, and smile! 
Feel that fresh blood rushing through your brain? You are recharged and energized! ⚡

D. PLAY OUTSIDE IN THE SUNSHINE! ☀️🏃🌿
Planet Earth is a magnificent playground filled with real-world adventures that no screen can ever duplicate:
- Play a game of tag in the backyard with your friends or siblings! 🏃‍♂️💨
- Kick a soccer ball across the grass and score a goal! ⚽🥅
- Ride a bicycle or scooter with your safety helmet strapped on! 🚲🪖
- Draw colourful hopscotch squares on the driveway with chalk! 🖍️
- Help your family water the tomato plants and smell the damp soil! 🪴🍅
- Build a secret fort out of sofa cushions and read an adventure book! 📚🏰
Outdoor sunshine gives your body Vitamin D, strengthens your bones, and lifts your mood! 

E. REAL-LIFE SAFETY SCENARIOS: 📱⏰
- Scenario 1: The Timer Rings ⏰ (Arjun's tablet timer rings during a space game. Arjun saves his game, turns off the screen, and runs outside to play catch with his dog!).
- Scenario 2: Asking Before New Shows 📺 (Maya wants to watch a new cartoon series on a streaming app. She asks Papa first; Papa approves the show, and they watch it together!).
- Scenario 3: The 20-Minute Garden Break 🏃☀️ (Kabir finishes a math module on his tablet, sets it down, and spends 20 minutes playing tag in the sunny courtyard with his cousin!).
- Scenario 4: Screen Distance Adjustment 📱 (Anya notices she is holding the tablet 5 inches from her nose. She pushes it back to an arm's length and sits up straight like a ballerina!).
- Scenario 5: Bedtime Screen Sunset 🌙 (One hour before bed, Rohan turns off all screens so his brain can produce natural melatonin for deep, sweet dreams!).

Balance is the secret to a happy, healthy, and brilliant life! You are now a master of your body and a master of your screen! 🌟🧘‍♂️💖

parts.title: The Symphony of Balance: Mind and Body in Harmony 🎻🧘‍♂️
parts.content: Imagine an orchestra where the trumpet plays as loud as it can for six hours without stopping while the violins sit silently. It would give everyone a giant headache! A healthy life is like a beautiful symphony where every instrument has its turn. Screens have their turn for learning and fun. Outdoor running has its turn for muscles and lungs. Books have their turn for quiet imagination. Sleep has its turn for healing and growth. When all parts play in balance, your life is full of music and joy! 🎶🌈

parts.title: Why Our Eyes Need the Distance Horizon 🌳👀
parts.content: Human eyes were designed across thousands of years to look at the wide horizon: tracking clouds, spotting berries on bushes, and gazing across grasslands. When you stare at a flat glass screen 10 inches from your face for hours, your tiny ciliary eye muscles stay tightly clenched. That causes eyestrain, headaches, and dry eyes. Looking out the window at a distant tree lets those muscles relax completely! Give your eyes the gift of the green horizon every single day! 🌲☁️

parts.title: The Chemistry of Sleep: Blue Light vs Melatonin 🌙🧠
parts.content: Why do adults ask us to turn off screens before bed? Electronic screens emit blue light that mimics bright noon daylight. When that light enters your eyes late at night, your brain gets tricked into thinking: 'Wait, the sun is shining! Don't produce melatonin (the sleep hormone)!' Putting screens away an hour before bedtime allows your body to release sweet, natural melatonin, wrapping you in deep, restorative slumber! 😴💤

parts.title: Sunshine, Vitamin D, and Living Earth ☀️🌱
parts.content: Did you know that your skin is a miniature solar-powered factory? When natural sunlight touches your skin, your body synthesizes Vitamin D, which makes your bones strong, your teeth tough, and your immune system resilient against colds! Running around outside on real grass also connects you to nature: you feel the wind, hear the birds, and smell the flowers. No video game graphics can ever compete with the living beauty of Earth! 🌍🌞

parts.title: You Are the Pilot of Your Technology ✈️🕹️
parts.content: Never let technology pilot you — YOU are the pilot of the technology! A screen is a tool, just like a hammer or a bicycle. You choose when to turn it on, what creative project to work on, when to turn it off, and when to go outside to play. When you live with boundaries, self-control, and mindfulness, you become a master of technology who leads a healthy, vibrant, and joyful life! 🌟🚀
